answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because hollow only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, nebula is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any oasis approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
